dct_description_sm:
This point feature class contains all of the current address points in Oakville.

The Town of Oakville assigns a municipal address to each property with a building. Oakville address points consist of a municipal address number and in some circumstances the address contains a unit number. The municipal address may contain a unit number if the building contains multiple owners or multiple tenants. The municipal address and the unit number will be displayed within the town’s geographic information system provided that the division of the building can be displayed in a two-dimensional view.

Note: Municipal address unit numbers will not be displayed within multi-level apartment or multi-level condominium buildings. Municipal address units for the division of commercial industrial buildings will rest with the property owner and will not be displayed within the town’s geographic information system.
